{{Quote|The Talisman of Age taps into the animal nature of humans, and briefly restores the vigor of youth.|Mother Talzin, ''Wild Power''|<ref name="BoS" />}}
The '''Talisman of Age''' was one of the [[Talisman of Transformation|Talismans of Transformation]], shapeshifting talismans owned by the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] used the Talisman of Age to tap into the animal nature of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] to restore the vigor of their youth for a brief [[Time/Legends|moment]]. Like all Nightsister artifacts, it was thought to work through the powers of the [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|Spirits]], beings said to be from a parallel realm in Nightsister mythology. In [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[Wild Power]]'', [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] [[Writing/Legends|wrote]] about the talisman and its effects.<ref name="BoS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Talisman of Age was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="BoS" />
